name: Magnitude 10 raises the critical chance of Flare Bolt (#727)
contract: #727: Magnitude 10 520485 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER 107 on SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (misc 7), bp 4 (+5), class mask B 0x2, which is the family flag of Flare Bolt 800790. Unit::GetUnitSpellCriticalChance applies the modifier through ApplySpellMod; nothing in src/ or modules/ references 520485. spell_done_crit_chance reads SpellDoneCritChance for a spell: Flare Bolt must gain exactly 5.0 points over its pre-passive value while Explode 800792 (mask A 0x200000, no B 0x2) is unchanged.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Flare Bolt gains 5 critical strike points
